description: This file contains the implementation of the ExecCommandResolution struct, which provides functionality to resolve command paths, parse shell commands, and generate string representations of command argument vectors. It is focused on handling command resolution, shell command parsing, and path expansion within an execution context.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct representing the resolution of a command to its executable path, including methods to resolve commands, parse shell commands, and manage command path expansion.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main method to resolve a command given its arguments, raw command string, working directory, and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves commands for allowlist processing, handling shell wrappers and command segments.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Collects patterns for commands that can always be allowed in the allowlist.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable path from a raw command or path string, expanding tilde and searching through PATH if needed.

methods.name: resolveShellSegmentExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable for a specific shell command segment.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects patterns of commands that are safe to allow in the allowlist.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Identifies and processes invocations of shell multiplexers like busybox or toybox.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Parses the first token of a command string, handling quotes.

methods.name: tokenizeShellWords
methods.description: Tokenizes a shell command string into individual command arguments, respecting quoting and escaping rules.

methods.name: splitShellCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a shell command chain into segments, respecting quotes, escapes, and delimiters.
